headline: 216 Appleton Street Phase 2 awarded $500k in historic tax credits; payment approved for South High Street feasibility study.
summary: Virgilio Property gave a six-month update on 123 Pine Street. Talks covered a Newton Street neighborhood action plan and a proposal to move $300K from the 216 Appleton Street project to help Newton Street homeowners, with a preference that the money go to the roof and smokestack. Minutes from June, July, and August 2026 were also approved.
decisions: Approved payment for the South High Street reuse analysis and redevelopment feasibility study, with 3 yes votes and 1 abstention.
Approved the minutes from June, July, and August 2026, 3-0.
City Council approved the transfer of 31, 43, and 61 Newton Street to HRA.
216 Appleton Street Phase 2 was awarded an additional $500k in historic tax credits.

transcript:
# Holyoke Redevelopment Authority

## Meeting Notice and Agenda

Wednesday, September 16, 2026 at 5:00 pm

Holyoke City Hall – Room 6

536 Dwight Street, Holyoke, MA

Or via Zoom: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/87917787709

Webinar ID: 879 1778 7709

Or by call-in at 1 (646) 931- 3860 with same Webinar ID

**Members Present:**

Patrick Beaudry, Chairperson

Tiffany Espinosa, Treasurer

Daphne Board, Assistant Treasurer

Karen Betournay, Member

**Staff Present:**

Eric Nakajima, Executive Director

John Dyjach, Asst. Director

Heather Kies, Development Specialist

**Others:**

Michael Bissonnette

Zach Virgilio, Virgilio Property Management, Inc.

1. **Item #1** Call to Order

   Chairperson Patrick Beaudry called the meeting to order at 5:06 p.m. and announced that the meeting is being recorded and being held virtually in accordance with State laws. A roll call followed:

   | Member | Present |
   |---|---|
   | Patrick Beaudry | X |
   | Daphne Board | X |
   | Tiffany Espinosa | X |

2. **Item #3a:** 123 Pine St

   a. Chairperson Beaudry asked in consideration of Virgilio Property being present to provide an update, that the board move out of order directly to Item 3a. Virgilio Property provided a 6-month update on progress of 123 Pine St. and discussed next steps.

   b. **Item #3b:** Chairperson Beaudry asked to move to item 3b in consideration of HRA member Karen Betournay joining the meeting remotely for discussion and approval of item 3bii.

   c. South High St Reuse Analysis & Redevelopment Feasibility Study

      i. Chairperson Beaudry recused himself from discussion and approvals due to a potential conflict of interest; turned the meeting over to Daphne Board.

      ii. Final report has been filed and distributed

      iii. **Item 3bii;** payment authorization

      iv. Tiffany Espinosa moved to authorize payment

      v. Karen Betournay seconded motion

      vi. Eric Nakajima reminded board that this expense is reimbursable from MA Development

   d. Roll Call:

      | Member | Yes/No |
      |---|---|
      | Karen Betournay | Yes |
      | Daphne Board | Yes |
      | Tiffany Espinosa | Yes |
      | Patrick Beaudry | (abstain) |

   e. 3biii: Next Steps

      i. Eric Nakajima: create a landing page on website for High & Newton

      ii. Neighborhood Action Plan for Newton St

         1. MA Development funds for additional studies

         2. Some parcels include Cabot St and High St

         3. Mayor convened inter-departmental group

            a. Meet 9.9.26

            b. Gave group until 9.18.26 to provide feedback

            c. Will send proposal to MA Development for approval

            d. Then back to board

         4. Community input is essential

         5. When will neighborhood be involved?

         6. Mayor Garcia, Councilor Rivera, Wayfinders and Eric Nakajima all met 9.16.26 to discuss community outreach

            a. The sooner the better

   f. Discussion regarding moving $300K from 216 Appleton St project to help current homeowners on Newton St improve their properties

      i. 216 Appleton is a roof project and very important

         1. Board would rather money go to roof/smokestack

         2. Winn received $200K from CPA

            a. Winn wants to reallocate the $200K they received from HRA from Phase I to Phase II

         3. Reallocation of funding is a difficult and long process

      ii. Next Steps

         1. Eric will call Winn regarding allocation of monies

   g. Discussion of CDBG funding/CPA

      i. Eric unsure of funding dates for CDBG.

3. **Item #2a:** Meeting Minutes

   a. Motion to accept minutes from June/July/August of 2026 by Tiffany Espinosa; seconded by Daphne Board

   b. Daphne Board is not Vice Chair; please fix

   c. Roll Call:

      | Member | Yes/No |
      |---|---|
      | Daphne Board | Yes |
      | Tiffany Espinosa | Yes |
      | Patrick Beaudry | Yes |

   d. Executive Director Report

      i. Meet Heather Kies, new Development Specialist

      ii. 216 Appleton (see discussion above)

      iii. Canal Row & Armor Yard closing in process for parking lot

         1. Agreement requires Chairperson Beaudry's signature

         2. Final review and approval required by State Executive Office of Housing and Livable COmmunities

4. **Item #4:** Other business

   a. City transfer of 31, 43, and 61 Newton Street to HRA approved by City Council

   b. Appleton St bridge replacement - MassDOT work appears to be ahead of schedule

   c. 216 Appleton Street Phase 2 awarded additional $500k in historic tax credits

5. **Item #5:** Adjournment

   a. Motion made by Daphne Board, seconded by Tiffany Espinosa

   b. Roll Call:

      | Member | Yes/No |
      |---|---|
      | Daphne Board | Yes |
      | Tiffany Espinosa | Yes |
      | Patrick Beaudry | Yes |

   c. Adjourned at 6:11p.m.

Respectfully Submitted,

Patrick Beaudry, Chairperson
